name: coursier-setup-action
description: Use Coursier to install JVM and Scala apps

jvm.description: JVM to install (leave empty to use default)

jvm-index.description: Arbitrary URL containing the JVM index source (leave empty to use default)

customRepositories.description: The pipe (|) seperated locations of non-standard repositories. See https://get-coursier.io/docs/other-repositories

disableDefaultRepos.description: Whether to pass the --no-default flag to coursier

extraJvmArgs.description: Space-separated list of -D JVM property args passed to every cs invocation. The -J prefix is added automatically if missing (e.g. -Dhttps.proxyHost=proxy.exampl

useContainerImage.description: Use the container-compatible Coursier launcher. When enabled, the action downloads the *-container launcher variant (built with -H:-UseContainerSupport).
